criteria.criterion: A commit touching only SECRETS_PATHS triggers an mcp redeploy, so refreshed .env values reach the container.
A test asserts the mcp delta gate covers SECRETS_PATHS, mirroring the review-bot's.
The pure-SSM-value-rotation case is documented as out of scope with its actual remedy named.

Bug 'MCP_PATHS omits SECRETS_PATHS, so a secrets-only change never triggers an mcp redeploy' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.

citations.description: Ticket f910-ae08-8002-4973 comment by Rebar Bot: 'AC4 (live validation) — DEFERRED TO DEPLOY WINDOW. Authored under a read-only-box constraint. AC4 requires observing a real secrets-only deploy on the box (autodeploy journal lines + the new mcp container identity carrying the refreshed value). That cannot be done from this change and must be recorded by an operator at the next secrets-only deploy. The code fix + its test land now; AC4 remains open for live verification.'

findings.criterion: [non-codebase] LIVE VALIDATION — DEFERRED TO DEPLOY WINDOW: At the next secrets-only deploy an operator must confirm the running mcp container's environment carries the newly-emitted value and record the autodeploy journal lines and the new container identity in a ticket comment.
findings.detail: This non-codebase criterion requires a concrete operator attestation in the ticket with specific verifiable details: autodeploy journal lines, new container identity, and timestamp from a live secrets-only deploy. No such attestation is visible in the ticket snapshot I read. The ticket and its comments explicitly acknowledge this is deferred and not yet satisfied — the second comment states 'AC4 remains open for live verification.'
findings.remediation: An operator must perform a secrets-only deploy on the production box, observe the autodeploy journal lines showing mcp rebuild and new container start, and record in a ticket comment: the specific autodeploy journal lines (including 'compose-build-mcp' and 'run --name rebar-mcp-…'), the new container identity/name, and the timestamp of the observation.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify. Note that a finding reporting a ticket record as absent means it was NOT VISIBLE IN THE TICKET SNAPSHOT THE VERIFIER READ — that snapshot is pinned when the run starts, so a record written after the pin, or not yet committed to the store, reads as missing even though it exists; re-verify after the write lands rather than re-recording evidence you already wrote.
